THE REVERSE ARM — reported for honesty, not decoration. Flagged_events_TP here are events the score GIVES UP relative to the SI heuristic (the NRI 'event down' cell); Flagged_nonevents_FP are escalations correctly AVOIDED (the NRI 'non-event down' cell). Escalations_per_event reads as escalations avoided per event lost.
Marginal of the 2x2: the arrival score used alone.
Marginal of the 2x2: the shock-index heuristic used alone.
COMPARATOR: escalations per event under a treat-all-elderly policy (= 1/prevalence). The newly-flagged arm must be read against this.

Definition: up-arm minus down-arm (score>=5 vs SI>=0.9, elderly)
Note: NET position of switching from the SI heuristic to the score. Signed differences, NOT counts — Wilson CIs do not apply to a difference of two dependent binomials and are left blank rather than faked. Escalations_per_event = net additional escalations per net additional event detected, and is left blank unless the net event change is positive (a ratio of two negatives is not a cost-per-benefit).
